profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Sirrus7
profile.summary:
Senior Full Stack Developer located in Orange County, CA that has engineered cross-functional solutions that automate operational workflows, synchronize digital ecosystems, and drive system efficiency. I've built everything from self-service enterprise tools used by global marketing teams to next-generation physical kiosks and startup mobile betas, and I enjoy building across the full stack: Frontend -> Backend -> Infrastructure.

I love React.js, C#, Typescript, and C++. For tooling, I prefer to use Claude Code and VS Code, and for infrastructure I enjoy using Terraform with Github or Gitlab CI/CD on Azure or AWS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated on the Starbucks Menu Platform Team to build self-service tools that automate the
synchronization of menu data across the company’s digital ecosystem using a React/TypeScript/C#/MongoDB stack
- Translated complex Figma designs into high-performance React and TypeScript views, delivering flawless visual experiences to millions of daily digital signage viewers
- Built robust customization features allowing marketing teams to differentiate product offerings by store type, region, and customer-facing interface
- Improved operational efficiency by bridging the gap between corporate marketing assets and store-level menu displays, reducing manual update overhead

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and tested a next-gen coffee kiosk in a 3-man team using a C++/Qt/QML stack
- Created subsystem models to simulate and optimize kiosk performance across diverse hardware components
- Launched a specialized API for seamless data transfer between LCD hardware and third-party middleware
- Programmed a middleware emulator, reducing testing dependency on external systems
- Developed functional frontend views directly from Adobe XD designs using QML
- Managed client relationships by offering direct technical expertise and resolving critical system bugs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated within a cross-functional four-person team to architect and launch a mobile beta and responsive landing page for a pre-Series A startup
- Engineered Figma designs into performant, functional views using React Native, ensuring a seamless user experience
- Optimized backend data flow by developing and maintaining Go-based API endpoints, facilitating efficient data processing and integration
- Engineered and provisioned scalable AWS cloud infrastructure and automated monitoring solutions using Terraform to ensure high availability, compliance, and proactive system health tracking
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Go (Programming Language) · Terraform · Datadog · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GitHub

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered core data processing features for a high-performance NoSQL database using C/C++
- Developed secure RESTful API endpoints to streamline internal product licensing and authorization
- Architected automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines, reducing build/QA cycle times across multiple operating -systems
- Spearheaded the organization-wide migration to Git/GitLab, accelerating developer workflows and providing technical training to team members
- Acted as primary technical liaison, providing expert troubleshooting to resolve client issues and improve product reliability

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered high-performance C++/Python applications for embedded medical device data retrieval and engineering control.
- Drove full-cycle software development (SDLC) within a heavily regulated environment, spanning requirements, documentation, implementation, and rigorous system validation.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Technical Documentation

positions.title: Software Implementation Consultant
positions.description:
- Collaborated with state stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver modernized, efficient software solutions for DMV systems
- Engineered and optimized robust .NET applications tailored for Tennessee DMV high-volume environments
- Boosted system performance by refining complex SQL queries and implementing strategic indexing, significantly accelerating data processing speeds

positions.title: CS Lab Assistant
positions.description:
- Tutored introductory computer science students in C, C++, Java, and Python
- Aided students as they completed their assignments, and guided them when any problems were encountered
- Communicated with faculty to identify frequently asked questions that students had regarding their coursework

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and Implemented the scripting functionality for an application supporting data retrieval and engineering control of an embedded medical device using the C++ programming language
- Developed in all facets of the software development life cycle, from requirements elicitation, design documentation, code implementation and system testing efforts in a heavily government regulated environment
- Communicated effectively with management and other team members to identify new tasks, as well as ensure all tasks are completed to their specifications

positions.title: Fulfillment Coordinator
positions.description:
- Managed the organization of product shelves so that supplies were always in stock and sorted according to company policy 
- Communicated with management each day in order to identify new organizational and administrative tasks needing completion

positions.title: Server Assistant
positions.description:
- Provided patrons with excellent service, ensuring that all needs were met
- Delivered food items to table in a professional and timely manner
- Communicated with kitchen and service staff to ensure accuracy of all orders
- Demonstrated substantial knowledge of menu items

positions.title: Front Team Member
positions.description:
- Participated as a member of an assessment team
- Identified prospective humanitarian projects for a non-profit 
- Provided community service to several villages throughout Uganda

positions.title: Team Coordinator
positions.description:
- Developed strong leadership skills by managing curriculum and activities for a large group 
- Coordinated recreational and team-building activities for adolescent boys ages 12-15
- Oversaw character building activities and other service projects
